lessons.title: Structural Neuroimaging: X-ray CT, MRI, & Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI)
lessons.description: Understand anatomical imaging: CT density, MRI magnetic fields and T1/T2 relaxation, and DTI white matter tractography.

lessons.title: Functional Brain Imaging: fMRI, BOLD Contrast, & PET Radiotracers
lessons.description: Master hemodynamic imaging: PET positron annihilation, fMRI BOLD hemodynamic response, subtraction logic, and neurovascular coupling.

lessons.title: Electrical Windows to the Mind: EEG, ERPs, & Magnetoencephalography (MEG)
lessons.description: Explore millisecond electrophysiology: EEG postsynaptic potentials, ERP components (P300, N400, N170), and magnetic field recording via MEG.

lessons.title: Causal Interventions: TMS, Lesion Studies, & Optogenetic Control
lessons.description: Move from correlation to causation: patient double dissociations, TMS 'virtual lesions', and cell-type specific optogenetic opsins.
